answer: New identities must arrive sponsored: a sparrow applicant needs a cipher-signed sponsorship from an established falcon agent, and each falcon may sponsor only one newcomer per epoch while locking 1,000 POA for 10 epochs, slashed if the newcomer is later proven a Sybil. The Nth clone needs an Nth distinct sponsor slot, and sponsor slots are scarce — a farm cannot mint, parallelise or bulk-buy them, so each extra clone costs a fresh established relationship plus a fresh locked bond.
